QUOTE: "`code` | ... | Restarting the MCP client only. A rebuild runs the old logic." and "`data` | ... | `index(action='refresh')`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table gives a different remedy per axis (rebuild/refresh for data, client restart for code, and a rebuild can't clear code). It never says why one flag wouldn't be enough, but the different-actions substance is stated.
